t: You're looking at the tomb of Emma and Alexis Soyer, in Kensington and Chelsea. Alexis Soyer was a French chef, writer and inventor who made his reputation in Victorian England. He commissioned this tomb and had a hand in making it, working with the Flemish sculptor Pierre Puyenbroeck, who also made it. It's an unusual thing to find: a monument shaped by a man best known for his cooking, set up in memory of Emma.
